entities.summary: Charles Stedman Garland was an American tennis player who won the 1920 Wimbledon men's doubles title with Richard Norris Williams. He reached the singles semi finals at Wimbledon in 1919 and 1920. His highest U.S. singles ranking was No. 8. He was inducted into the International Tennis Hall of Fame in 1969.
